mentions.name: Budget rowing stroke counter
mentions.description: A low-cost stroke counter for rowers that measures strokes per minute using cheap off-the-shelf parts. It already counts strokes fairly accurately and initial tests of the display have been completed.
mentions.problem: Training devices that competitive rowers use to count strokes per minute are expensive; this project builds a budget version from inexpensive individual parts.
mentions.source_excerpt: A cheap rowing counter. Competitive rowers use a training device that counts their strokes per minute. I figured out that the major parts are really cheap, even as individual purchases, so I wanted to build a budget version. So far it counts strokes fairly accurately and I've just completed initial tests of the display.
mentions.author: aprentic
